metadata.date_balanced_frequency_semantics: mean of per-date within-date frequencies; every supported date has equal weight and missing fields do not enter the denominator
metadata.date_balanced_low_ci_static_dbzh_quantil: parallel audit statistic conditioned on low CI; retained as uncalibrated auxiliary evidence and not used as clutter truth
metadata.date_balanced_static_dbzh_quantiles: percentiles across per-date median DBZH conditioned on echo presence, near-zero VRAD, and within-date static qualification; CI is not used as a label
promotion_blockers: desktop and iOS parity is incomplete
metadata.pseudoreplication_control: each date contributes at most one persistence/static vote
